name: Lying Chest Press Machine
how_to:
Setup

1. Adjust the seat height so that the handles align with the mid-chest level when seated.
2. Sit back with your spine firmly against the backrest and feet planted flat on the ground.
3. Grip the handles with an overhand grip, ensuring your wrists remain straight.
Execution

1. Starting Position
  - Hold the handles with your arms extended but elbows slightly bent to avoid locking out.
  - Engage your core and keep your shoulders down and back.
2. Lowering Phase
  - Slowly bring the handles toward your chest, maintaining a controlled motion.
  - Stop when your elbows are at or slightly below chest level.
3. Pressing Phase
  - Push the handles back to the starting position by extending your arms, squeezing your chest at the top of the movement.
4. Repeat: Perform for the desired number of repetitions while maintaining control and proper form.
Tips for Maximum Effectiveness
1. Focus on Muscle Contraction: Squeeze your chest at the top of the press to maximize muscle engagement.
2. Control the Eccentric Phase: Lower the handles slowly to increase time under tension and promote muscle growth.
3. Pair with Free Weights: Combine with exercises like the bench press or dumbbell fly for a well-rounded chest workout.
4. Vary Grip Positions: Use different grips (narrow or wide) to target different areas of the chest.
5. Breathe Properly: Exhale as you press the handles up and inhale as you lower them back.
